Spurs @ Jazz 3/10 4:00 - Fox out, Wemby should cruise
Knicks @ Raptors 7/10 5:00 - Barnes questionable, tight game likely
Mavs @ Celtics 5/10 5:00 - Flagg showcase, Irving out

games.notes: Barnes questionable, Kawhi and Bittle out for Toronto. Defending champ Knicks against a young Raptors team at home, should be a competitive one.
Irving and Christie out, Aldama questionable for Dallas, who are on a back-to-back. Watch for Flagg against Tatum and Brown, but Boston should win comfortably.
Capela and VanVleet out, Smart suspended for Houston; Tre Johnson questionable for Washington. Sengun and a thin Rockets team should still win, likely not close.
Reaves and Carr out for the Lakers. Luka and the Lakers against a Suns team without Mark Williams, likely a Lakers win.
Fox and Harris out for the Spurs; Markkanen, Jackson and Hayes out for Utah. Wemby and the Spurs should cruise, likely blowout.
Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Wallace out, Mitchell questionable for OKC; Simmons and Raynaud out for Sacramento. Gilgeous-Alexander against a bad Kings team, likely lopsided.
Embiid out for Philadelphia; Haliburton and Nembhard out for Indiana. Already finished, a Sixers win, nothing to chase.
Knueppel and Schroder out for Charlotte; Ingram and Beal out for the Clippers. Two depleted teams, skip.
Landale questionable for Atlanta, Rollins questionable for Milwaukee. A middling Hawks team against a Bucks team that is 1-12, skip.
